function.name: GET_ID
function.param: A type of process, obtained with the instruction .
function.abstract: It allows to cross the list of active processes, or find any active process of a given type

description.p: This function returns the identifier of the first process that it finds corresponds to the specified type, and it returns his identifier (). If it does not find any, this function returns 0.

In the following calls to this function that we make using the same parameter, GET_ID returns the identifiers of the following processes of that type that are on memory, until there are not any, in which case it returns 0.

The state of GET_ID reboots each frame, and it is local to each process, then a GET_ID made by one process it does not affect to other GET_ID made by other process, even with the same parameters, nor to the same GET_ID if it is called again to the next frame.
It is possible to call GET_ID with the parameter of the type of process 0. In that case, GET_ID will return the identifiers of all processes on memory, of any type.
GET_ID will never return identifier of killed or marked processes to kill the next frame by the function .
